500-7845--178--179.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying its mana cost targeting the creature that can recur spells.
When you cast that spell, Spinerock Tyrant triggers, copying Saw in Half and choosing Spinerock Tyrant as its target.
Resolve the copy of Saw in Half, creating two Spinerock Tyrant tokens, except their power and toughness are halved to a minimum of 1.
Resolve the original Saw in Half, creating two token copies of the spell recursion creature, except their power and toughness are halved to a minimum of 1.
When those tokens enter, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and another target card of the appropriate type from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Saw in Half by paying its mana cost targeting the creature that can recur spells.
When you cast that spell, each copy of Spinerock Tyrant triggers, copying Saw in Half once for each Spinerock Tyrant and choosing a different copy of Spinerock Tyrant as each additional spell's target
Resolve the copies of Saw in Half, creating four Spinerock Tyrant tokens, except their power and toughness are halved to a minimum of 1.
Resolve the original Saw in Half, creating two token copies of the spell recursion creature, except their power and toughness are halved to a minimum of 1.
When those tokens enter, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and another target card of the appropriate type from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast the spell that creates a Treasure token by paying its mana cost, targeting any creature.
Each copy of Spinerock Tyrant triggers, copying that spell once for each Spinerock Tyrant you control.
Resolve all copies of that spell, creating at least one Treasure token each time.
Activate those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding one mana per Treasure.
Cast Saw in Half by paying its mana cost targeting the spell recursion creature.
When you cast that spell, each copy of Spinerock Tyrant triggers, copying Saw in Half once for each Spinerock Tyrant and choosing a different copy of Spinerock Tyrant as each additional spell's target.
Resolve all copies of that spell, creating two copies of the spell recursion creature and additional copies of Spinerock Tyrant.
When the first spell recursion creature token enters, it triggers, returning the spell that creates Treasure from your graveyard to your hand.
 When the second spell recursion creature token enters, it triggers, returning Saw in Half from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 11.
500-7845--178--179.notes: The mana needed is calculated assuming you use a spell that costs 2 to cast and creates one Treasure token.

1825-2232-3400--170.easyPrerequisites: There's another creature on the battlefield.
1825-2232-3400--170.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce {3}{U}{U} plus enough mana to cast the other Aura spell after the lands are tapped twice.
1825-2232-3400--170.description:
Cast Treachery by paying {3}{U}{U}, targeting another creature.
Ivy triggers, copying Treachery, with the copy targeting Ivy.
Resolve the copy of Treachery, attaching it to Ivy.
When the Treachery copy enters, it and Cloudstone Curio triggers.
Resolve the Treachery trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the original Treachery, attaching it to the targeted creature and causing you to gain control of that creature.
When Treachery enters, it and Cloudstone Curio triggers.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding an amount of mana.
Resolve the Treachery trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Aura from the battlefield to your hand if it's on the battlefield. If it isn't on the battlefield, then return nothing to your hand.
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding an amount of mana.
Cast the other Aura by paying its mana cost, targeting another creature.
Ivy triggers, copying the Aura, with the copy targeting Ivy.
Resolve the copy of the Aura, attaching it to Ivy.
When the Aura copy enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers. Choose to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the original Aura, attaching it to the targeted creature.
When the Aura enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning the nontoken Treachery from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1825-2232-3400--170.notes: The combo is written assuming the other Aura enchants a creature. If it doesn't, the combo will still function, but you will not get additional copies that attach to Ivy. You can also elect to not have those copies attach to Ivy, even if they do attach to creatures. To get infinite mana and untap of lands, you must use an Aura with mana value 4 or less, or have a land that adds multiple mana.
